ambient_events: Sun-warmed teak ticks softly as it expands under the open sky.
The jacuzzi murmurs to itself, a low ring of steam curling off the turquoise water.
A gull rides the wind off the Basin, hangs a moment, and wheels away.
description: The sun deck: the Echelon's topmost terrace, open to the whole sky. Pale teak underfoot, a long curved run of cushioned loungers, and a sunken jacuzzi steaming quietly at its heart, lit turquoise from below. The Basin spreads out on every side and up here the wind smells only of salt and money. A stair descends (DOWN) to the landing. You can LOOK EAST or WEST out across the water.
name: Echelon — Sun Deck
